item.title: Rwanda set to hit British taxpayers with £50 MILLION bill as Labour SUED over abandoned asylum plan
item.description: Britain is being sued for millions of pounds by Rwanda after Labour scrapped the asylum deal between the two countries.The British taxpayer could be set to fork out more than £50million after the East African nation launched legal action.The Netherlands-based Permanent Court of Arbitration is handling the dispute.Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer made scrapping the Rwanda bill one of his first acts upon taking office.
